+package database
+
+import (
+	"context"
+	"errors"
+	"net"
+	"strings"
+	"syscall"
+
+	"github.com/gravitational/trace"
+	mssql "github.com/microsoft/go-mssqldb"
+	"github.com/microsoft/go-mssqldb/msdsn"
+	"github.com/sirupsen/logrus"
+
+	"github.com/gravitational/teleport/lib/defaults"
+)
+
+// SQLServerPinger tests connections to SQL Server databases.
+type SQLServerPinger struct{}
+
+// Ping connects to the database and runs a simple query to verify the connection.
+func (p *SQLServerPinger) Ping(ctx context.Context, params PingParams) error {
+	if err := params.CheckAndSetDefaults(defaults.ProtocolSQLServer); err != nil {
+		return trace.Wrap(err)
+	}
+	if params.Port < 1 || params.Port > 65535 {
+		return trace.BadParameter("invalid Port %d", params.Port)
+	}
+
+	// The driver does not interrupt all prelogin reads when its context expires.
+	// Closing the socket on cancellation also bounds those reads.
+	pingCtx, cancel := context.WithCancel(ctx)
+	defer cancel()
+
+	connector := mssql.NewConnectorConfig(msdsn.Config{
+		Host:       params.Host,
+		Port:       uint64(params.Port),
+		User:       params.Username,
+		Database:   params.DatabaseName,
+		Encryption: msdsn.EncryptionDisabled, // The local Teleport tunnel handles encryption.
+		Protocols:  []string{"tcp"},
+	}, nil)
+	connector.Dialer = sqlServerDialer{ctx: pingCtx}
+	conn, err := connector.Connect(pingCtx)
+	if err != nil {
+		if ctx.Err() != nil {
+			return trace.Wrap(ctx.Err())
+		}
+		return trace.Wrap(err)
+	}
+	defer func() {
+		if err := conn.Close(); err != nil {
+			logrus.WithError(err).Info("Failed to close connection in SQLServerPinger.Ping")
+		}
+	}()
+
+	mssqlConn, ok := conn.(*mssql.Conn)
+	if !ok {
+		return trace.BadParameter("expected *mssql.Conn, got %T", conn)
+	}
+	if err := mssqlConn.Ping(pingCtx); err != nil {
+		if ctx.Err() != nil {
+			return trace.Wrap(ctx.Err())
+		}
+		return trace.Wrap(err)
+	}
+	return nil
+}
+
+type sqlServerDialer struct{ ctx context.Context }
+
+func (d sqlServerDialer) DialContext(ctx context.Context, network, address string) (net.Conn, error) {
+	var dialer net.Dialer
+	conn, err := dialer.DialContext(ctx, network, address)
+	if err != nil {
+		return nil, err
+	}
+	context.AfterFunc(d.ctx, func() { _ = conn.Close() })
+	return conn, nil
+}
+
+// IsConnectionRefusedError reports whether SQL Server was unreachable.
+func (p *SQLServerPinger) IsConnectionRefusedError(err error) bool {
+	if err == nil {
+		return false
+	}
+	if errors.Is(err, syscall.ECONNREFUSED) || errors.Is(err, syscall.EHOSTUNREACH) ||
+		errors.Is(err, syscall.ENETUNREACH) || sqlServerErrorNumber(err) == 53 {
+		return true
+	}
+	message := strings.ToLower(err.Error())
+	return strings.Contains(message, "connection refused") || strings.Contains(message, "no route to host")
+}
+
+// IsInvalidDatabaseUserError reports whether SQL Server rejected the login.
+func (p *SQLServerPinger) IsInvalidDatabaseUserError(err error) bool {
+	if err == nil {
+		return false
+	}
+	if number := sqlServerErrorNumber(err); number != 0 && number != 28353 {
+		return number == 18456
+	}
+	return strings.Contains(strings.ToLower(err.Error()), "login failed for user") &&
+		!p.IsInvalidDatabaseNameError(err)
+}
+
+// IsInvalidDatabaseNameError reports whether SQL Server rejected the database name.
+func (p *SQLServerPinger) IsInvalidDatabaseNameError(err error) bool {
+	if err == nil {
+		return false
+	}
+	switch sqlServerErrorNumber(err) {
+	case 4060, 911:
+		return true
+	case 0, 28353:
+		message := strings.ToLower(err.Error())
+		return strings.Contains(message, "cannot open database") ||
+			(strings.Contains(message, "database") && strings.Contains(message, "does not exist"))
+	default:
+		return false
+	}
+}
+
+func sqlServerErrorNumber(err error) int32 {
+	var sqlErr interface{ SQLErrorNumber() int32 }
+	if errors.As(err, &sqlErr) {
+		return sqlErr.SQLErrorNumber()
+	}
+	return 0
+}

+
+func TestSQLServerErrors(t *testing.T) {
+	p := SQLServerPinger{}
+	tests := []struct {
+		name    string
+		err     error
+		refused bool
+		user    bool
+		db      bool
+	}{
+		{name: "nil"},
+		{name: "connection refused", err: fmt.Errorf("dial: %w", syscall.ECONNREFUSED), refused: true},
+		{name: "connection refused text", err: errors.New("dial tcp: connection refused"), refused: true},
+		{name: "server unreachable", err: mssql.Error{Number: 53}, refused: true},
+		{name: "invalid user", err: trace.Wrap(mssql.Error{Number: 18456}), user: true},
+		{name: "proxied invalid user", err: mssql.Error{Number: 28353, Message: "Login failed for user 'missing'"}, user: true},
+		{name: "invalid database", err: &mssql.Error{Number: 4060}, db: true},
+		{name: "database does not exist", err: mssql.Error{Number: 911}, db: true},
+		{name: "proxied invalid database", err: mssql.Error{Number: 28353, Message: "Cannot open database 'missing' requested by the login. The login failed."}, db: true},
+		{name: "other error", err: mssql.Error{Number: 1205}},
+	}
+	for _, tt := range tests {
+		t.Run(tt.name, func(t *testing.T) {
+			require.Equal(t, tt.refused, p.IsConnectionRefusedError(tt.err))
+			require.Equal(t, tt.user, p.IsInvalidDatabaseUserError(tt.err))
+			require.Equal(t, tt.db, p.IsInvalidDatabaseNameError(tt.err))
+		})
+	}
+}
+
+func TestSQLServerPing(t *testing.T) {
+	testServer, err := sqlserver.NewTestServer(common.TestServerConfig{AuthClient: setupMockClient(t)})
+	require.NoError(t, err)
+	go func() {
+		_ = testServer.Serve()
+	}()
+	t.Cleanup(func() { require.NoError(t, testServer.Close()) })
+
+	port, err := strconv.Atoi(testServer.Port())
+	require.NoError(t, err)
+
+	ctx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(context.Background(), 5*time.Second)
+	defer cancel()
+	p := SQLServerPinger{}
+	require.NoError(t, p.Ping(ctx, PingParams{
+		Host: "localhost", Port: port, Username: "someuser", DatabaseName: "somedb",
+	}))
+}
+
+func TestSQLServerPingDeadline(t *testing.T) {
+	listener, err := net.Listen("tcp", "127.0.0.1:0")
+	require.NoError(t, err)
+	defer listener.Close()
+	go func() {
+		conn, err := listener.Accept()
+		if err == nil {
+			defer conn.Close()
+			_, _ = io.Copy(io.Discard, conn)
+		}
+	}()
+
+	ctx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(context.Background(), 50*time.Millisecond)
+	defer cancel()
+	p := SQLServerPinger{}
+	err = p.Ping(ctx, PingParams{
+		Host: "127.0.0.1", Port: listener.Addr().(*net.TCPAddr).Port,
+		Username: "someuser", DatabaseName: "somedb",
+	})
+	require.ErrorIs(t, err, context.DeadlineExceeded)
+}
+
+func TestSQLServerPingParams(t *testing.T) {
+	p := SQLServerPinger{}
+	for _, params := range []PingParams{
+		{Port: 1433, DatabaseName: "db"},
+		{Port: 1433, Username: "user"},
+		{Username: "user", DatabaseName: "db"},
+		{Port: 65536, Username: "user", DatabaseName: "db"},
+	} {
+		require.Error(t, p.Ping(context.Background(), params))
+	}
+}
